_arm: MLR-Agent (MLR-Bench reference agent, claude backend), chchenhui/mlrbench, MIT
_provenance: experimenter-supplied; declared by hand from the released directory layout BEFORE any audit of this arm.
_substrate_caveat: Captured by the MLR-Bench authors, not by us at a sandbox boundary. Cross-arm comparability resting on a uniform capture boundary does not extend to this arm.
_holdout_split: iclr2025_dl4c is the DEVELOPMENT task for the Markdown path; the remaining nine are held out.
_claim_side: results/paper_<model>.md -- three manuscripts are written from ONE set of artifacts, which makes generator and evidence separable within a single arm.

excluded_rationale.results/paper_*.md: the claim side, not the artifact side
excluded_rationale.claude_output.json: raw conversation trace; not an aggregate a manuscript cites
excluded_rationale.results/*.png: rendered figures; the numbers behind them are in results.md
